headline: West Coast Paper Mills reports significant price movement
hook: Unusual price swing triggers exchange notice
summary: The stock of West Coast Paper Mills Ltd showed a notable price movement, prompting the NSE to issue a notice to the company. The exchange wrote to West Coast Paper Mills seeking clarification and to keep investors informed. The company has submitted its response to the exchange. Such regulatory scrutiny may affect shareholders as it could lead to further disclosures or trading constraints.

headline: West Coast Paper shares surge 10% and deliver 133% gains in seven months
hook: Mukul Agrawal backed paper stock doubles
summary: West Coast Paper Mills shares rose 10 percent in recent trading sessions, driven by strong momentum in the stock. The counter has delivered multibagger returns of 133 percent over the past seven months. Prominent investor Mukul Agrawal holds a stake in the company. Retail investors should track such momentum plays backed by ace investors for short-term volatility.
why_it_matters: Ace investor portfolio stock sees strong retail momentum.
winners_losers: Existing shareholders gain / new buyers face high valuations

headline: West Coast Paper Mills and several other stocks hit 52-week highs
summary: West Coast Paper Mills hit its 20 percent upper circuit at ₹873.40, marking a 110 percent gain in calendar year 2026. The broader BSE Sensex fell 16 percent over the same period. PVR Inox, Sky Gold, Neogen Chemicals, PTC Industries, and KMEW also touched their 52-week highs.
